cards.review_notes: Opening is promised by Thanksgiving, not necessarily on November 26. The rate table says two sessions receive $200 off tuition, while a later paragraph says $250; listed prices follow the explicit table. Session 1's waitlist label remains on the page despite the 2026 session being past. Campus address is WCU's published general address; a specific check-in building was not identified.

cards.name: ADTC ULTIMATE Smoky Mountains (day)
cards.description: Day campers join overnight campers for dance classes and camp activities, from morning warm-up through evening all-camp activities.

season.text: 2027 camp dates and Holiday Enrollment will be available by Thanksgiving.

hours.text: Day campers participate in all dance classes and activities with overnight campers from 8:45am warm-up through 9:30pm pick-up after all-camp night activities.

lunch.text: Day campers must pay the “Meal Plan” fee for their number of sessions. The “Meal Plan” fee includes three meals per-day from Sunday night dinner through Saturday morning breakfast.

cards.review_notes: The undated general policies page permits day campers at overnight camps; session dates are taken from the 2026 North Carolina overnight schedule. Confirm day attendance dates, fees and check-in building. No day-specific 2027 registration milestones are stated.

cards.name: Dance Camp CIT Program
cards.description: Counselors-in-training attend dance classes and camp activities while developing leadership skills through workshops, program planning and supervised work with younger campers.
cards.review_notes: CITs must attend at least two weeks at any ADTC camp; the North Carolina span is derived from its two 2026 sessions. The CIT page welcomes applicants without prior ADTC experience, but the policies page requires two prior summers. The undated CIT page says first-year participants pay regular tuition, second-year participants half price and third-plus-year participants attend free; dollar prices and room-and-board treatment were left unspecified. April 15 application and May 15 notification deadlines are undated and not assigned to 2027.
